info.title: AirQuality
info.description: Live air quality for any place on earth (Open-Meteo). No key needed.

get.summary: Get the current European Air Quality Index (EAQI) and fine dust values for a location.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the city, for example 48.78 for Stuttgart.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the city, for example 9.18 for Stuttgart.

parameters.name: current
parameters.description: Always send exactly this text: european_aqi,pm2_5,pm10
